findings.finding: The exhaustive additional-file allowlist excludes nine evidence files per mode that the evidence section requires, including stager-pre.json and failure.txt.
findings.required: Put the fresh packet root, mode roots, all stager-created directories/files and every runner/evidence file in one authoritative exact creation allowlist.

findings.finding: The packet says ordinary return_value and publication return Ok(true), but return_value returns Result<()> and ends in Ok(()); only publish returns Ok(true).
findings.required: Specify each call and result separately.

findings.finding: Worker::new rejects nonpositive TIDs before admission, so the prescribed construction chain proves worker validation rather than verification_prepare_retained's negative-TID path.
findings.required: Specify a bounded direct consuming-Response negative test, returned-Response retention and teardown without inventing a private Call constructor.

findings.finding: verification_phase_completion rejects prepared wake-None completions, and the packet delegates rows 01-27 to attempt 6 even though attempt 6 has no complete matrix.
findings.required: Supply the complete row/subcase matrix, preparation and phase-setting order, exact results, cancellation results and first-invalid values; omit or state the exact phase-completion rejection for wake-None. Row 27 cancellation is Ok(()) after publication removes the call.

findings.finding: Mode-2 publish succeeds and releases; the separate -5 comes from stability_fault_notify, whose matching identity arguments and callback observations are not prescribed. The selected send path also requires a positive ktime_get provider, but the packet defines a clock provider only for mode 3.
findings.required: Specify the separate mode-2 notification call and observations plus a positive mode-2 clock provider.

accepted_packet_components: both consuming preparation signatures and selected-error restoration
aligned guarded allocation and deferred release/quarantine ledger
disposition: One bounded packet correction may address only these source-bound findings. No implementation is released. Native backing and lease ownership remain blocked by review 7.
